Position guides for three-dimensional axes

Source: R/guides-3d.R
guide_axis_3d.Rd

Tick labels and titles are measured in the drawing viewport. Automatic placement uses an exterior cube edge. Integer positions 1 through 4 select a fixed edge in lexicographic order of its two fixed coordinates. Position "origin" draws the axis through the origin point of coord_3d() as part of the scene, with ticks, tick labels and title in three dimensions; coord_3d(axis_lines = "origin") places every guide with position "auto" there. Labels are thinned automatically using their measured extents along the edge.

Usage

guide_axis_3d(
  title = ggplot2::waiver(),
  theme = NULL,
  position = "auto",
  check.overlap = FALSE,
  angle = ggplot2::waiver(),
  n.dodge = 1L,
  minor.ticks = FALSE,
  cap = "none",
  order = 0L,
  label.orientation = "screen",
  plane = "auto",
  title.position = "centre",
  depth.scale = FALSE,
  ticks = "outward"
)

Arguments

title

Guide title, with waiver inheriting the scale or plot title.

theme

Local theme overrides.

position

"auto", a side (top, bottom, left, right), edge 1 to 4, or "origin".

check.overlap

Use extra clearance between measured label rectangles.

angle

Label rotation in degrees for label.orientation = "screen". Waiver keeps labels horizontal.

n.dodge

Number of parallel label rows.

minor.ticks

Draw minor ticks.

cap

Trim the lower, upper, both, or neither end to major breaks.

order

Guide ordering value.

label.orientation

"screen", "edge" or "plane": tick labels upright on the page, turned along the projected edge and kept upright, or lying in a pane. Titles follow the edge in every orientation and lie in the pane with "plane".

plane

Pane for plane labels and in-plane ticks: "auto", "floor", "xy", "xz" or "yz". The pane must contain the axis.

title.position

"centre" places the title beside the middle of the axis, beyond the tick labels; "near" places it at the end nearer the camera. Screen titles sit past that endpoint; plane titles sit inside the pane boundary.

depth.scale

Under perspective projection, scale tick labels and tick lengths by their distance from the camera: FALSE (none), TRUE (full), or a nonnegative strength s, which maps the ratio d of the distance of the camera target to the distance of the tick to d^s, as scale_depth in ggcube. Titles are not scaled. Plane labels and in-plane ticks are foreshortened by the projection itself.

ticks

"outward" draws ticks on the page, perpendicular to the projected edge; "in_plane" draws them into the pane, perpendicular to the edge in three dimensions. Plane labels and ticks depth-sort with data.

Value

A ggplot2 guide for a three-dimensional position axis.

Details

Tick labels can stand upright on the page (label.orientation = "screen"), turn with the projected edge they label ("edge", as rotate_labels in ggcube and the automatic label rotation of Makie's Axis3), or lie flat in one of the two box panes that meet at the edge ("plane"), drawn from the glyph outlines of the font so that perspective foreshortens them like the panes. ticks = "in_plane" points the ticks into the same pane, with a length that shrinks with distance from the camera. The pane is chosen with plane: "auto" takes the pane in which the ticks stand out furthest from the edge on the page, "floor" the pane normal to the vertical axis of the camera, and "xy", "xz" or "yz" a pane by the two axes it spans, as with the edge codes of rgl's axis3d().

Plane typography needs the 'systemfonts' package, which reads the glyph outlines, and character labels. Use screen orientation for plotmath expressions.

References

Kling M (2025). ggcube: 3D plotting with ggplot2. coord_3d() arguments rotate_labels, scale_depth and title_position.

Danisch S, Krumbiegel J (2021). Makie.jl: Flexible high-performance data visualization for Julia. Journal of Open Source Software 6(65), 3349.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(1, 2, 1), z = 1:3)
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) + geom_point_3d()
p + scale_z_continuous(guide = guide_axis_3d()) + coord_3d()
p + scale_z_continuous(guide = guide_axis_3d(position = "origin")) +
  coord_3d(origin = c(x = 2, y = 1.5))
p + ggplot2::guides(x = guide_axis_3d(label.orientation = "edge"),
                    y = guide_axis_3d(label.orientation = "edge")) +
  coord_3d()
if (requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p + ggplot2::guides(x = guide_axis_3d(label.orientation = "plane", ticks = "in_plane"),
                      y = guide_axis_3d(label.orientation = "plane", ticks = "in_plane")) +
    coord_3d(projection = "perspective")
}
p + ggplot2::guides(z = guide_axis_3d(title.position = "near", depth.scale = TRUE)) +
  coord_3d(projection = "perspective")
